name: Traditional Sheep & Goat Milk Feta Cheese (Crumbled in Brine)
whyItWorks: Traditional authentic feta is made from sheep and goat milk, which naturally contains A2 casein proteins and lower lactose than cow's milk. Tangy and flavorful in small quantities.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Rinse briefly in cold water if you need to reduce surface brine sodium before crumbling over roasted potatoes or chicken.
